sentences.text: Md. Zahid @ Md. Jahid, aged about 34 years, son of Md. Ibrahim, resident of Mohalla - Muslim Nagar (Churighar), P.O. and P.S. - Daltonganj, District - Palamu ... ...

Petitioner Versus 1. The State of Jharkhand 2. Sitara Praveen, wife of Md. Zahid and daughter of Md. Jahangir, resident of Ansar Nagar, Ward No. 14, P.O. Chatra, P.S. ChatraSadar, District - Chatra ... ... ...

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR RAI -------
For the Petitioner :Mrs. JasvindarMazumdar, Advocate  Mr. Ayush Deb, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, A.P.P.
For the Informant : Mr. A. K. Chaturvedy, Advocate  ------
Order No.06/Dated 03rd October, 2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1336 of 2023, instituted under Sections 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of D.P. Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner-husband submitted that it is matrimonial dispute and dispute has been settled by entering into an agreement between petitioner/husband and opposite party no.
2/wife but as the agreement arrived at between them before Mediation Centre, Civil Court, Chatra stage of payment of Rs. 3,25,000/- out of Rs. 6,50,000/- by petitioner/husband to opposite party no. 2/wife is not clear, as such, to clarify, one interlocutory application being I.A.(Cr.) No. 11014 of 2024 has been filed, clarifying further to agreement dated 12.08.2024 and this interlocutory application has been well supported by an affidavit of petitioner/husband as well as opposite party no. 2/wife.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2/wife conceded to the fact what has been stated by Md. Zahid @ Md. Jahid vs The State Of Jharkhand on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191837005/
1 learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. Perusal of record transpires that it is a matrimonial dispute between petitioner/husband and opposite party no. 2/wife, opposite party no. 2/wife has filed a complaint case being Complaint Case No. 1336 of 2023 and concerned court has summoned petitioner/husband.
6.

entities.text: Md. Zahid @ Md. Jahid vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It further transpires that both the sides entered into compromise before Mediation Centre, Civil Court, Chatra in which it has been agreed between the parties that petitioner/husband shall pay Rs.
6,50,000/- to opposite party no. 2/wife out of which a demand draft dated 17.09.2024 for Rs.
3,25,000/- in favour of opposite party no. 2/wife has already been paid to opposite party no. 2/wife today itself.
7.

After perusing the above said interlocutory application, it transpires that parties have agreed regarding remaining payment of Rs. 3,25,000/- at the stage mentioned in the said interlocutory application.

8. Petitioner/husband and opposite party no. 2/wife are directed to stick to their respective words stated in agreement dated 12.08.2024 and interlocutory application being I.A. (Cr.) No. 11014 of 2024.
9.

Considering the submission advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and also the fact that compromise has already been arrived at between the parties, this Court finds it is a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail and accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Chatra, in connection with Complaint Case No. 1336 of 2023.
10. Petitioner/husband and opposite party no. 2/wife are directed to abide by the term and conditions of above stated agreement dated 12.08.2024 and I.A. (Cr.) No. 11014 of 2024.
11. I.A.(Cr.) NO. 11014 of 2024 stands disposed of accordingly.
(Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Umesh/-
